nodes.description: bytes32 state variable holding the keccak256 hash of the secret key; zero means uninitialized.
address state variable set to msg.sender at deployment; used as privileged address.
Caller-controlled address used in authorization checks and as ether transfer recipient.
Origin of the transaction, compared against msg.sender in withdraw; phishing/tx.origin dependency.
Public payable function that validates key against keyHash and transfers the whole balance when msg.value > 0.5 ether.
Public function initializing keyHash from the supplied key when it is still zero.
Public function setting keyHash directly from a bytes32 argument when it is still zero.
Public function restricted to owner that selfdestructs the contract sending funds to owner.
Public view function returning the owner address.
Unnamed payable fallback function that accepts ether without logic.
msg.sender.transfer(address(this).balance) sending the full contract balance to the untrusted caller.
selfdestruct(owner) destroying the contract and forcing funds to the owner address.
string key parameter of withdraw, hashed and compared to keyHash.
string key parameter of setup, hashed into keyHash.
bytes32 _keyHash parameter of new_hash assigned to the keyHash state variable.

edges.reason: Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
withdraw requires msg.sender == tx.origin, so the caller controls the authorization branch.
tx.origin is used as the authorization value in withdraw, creating a tx.origin dependency.
extract checks msg.sender against the owner address for privileged access.
extract requires msg.sender == owner, so the owner state variable gates the privileged call.
withdraw reads keyHash to compare against the hashed key argument.
setup reads keyHash to test whether it is still uninitialized.
new_hash reads keyHash to test whether it is still uninitialized.
withdraw branches into the balance transfer to msg.sender when value exceeds 0.5 ether.
The untrusted caller address is the recipient of the full balance transfer, enabling reentrant state abuse.
extract unconditionally reaches the selfdestruct operation after the owner check.
selfdestruct sends the remaining balance to the owner state variable.
withdraw parameter key is hashed and used in the keyHash comparison.
setup parameter key is hashed and stored into keyHash.
new_hash parameter _keyHash is assigned to the keyHash state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The key parameter is only meaningful inside withdraw, where it is hashed and compared with keyHash; fold it into the withdraw function node.
The key parameter is used solely by setup to derive keyHash; merge it into the setup function node.
The _keyHash parameter is directly stored into keyHash only by new_hash; absorb it into the new_hash function node.
